description: atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets (zone alea) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 14 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zone d'aléa Mouvement de terrain - commune de PILA-CANALE; Zone d'aléa Mouvements de terrain - commune d'OTA; Zone d'aléa Mouvement de terrain - communes d'ALTAGENE et ZOZA; Zone d'aléa du PPRN Mouvement de terrain de Balogna. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
